prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-02, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-02):
| Return 3m            | +28.8% |
| Return 1m            | -6.3% |
| Return 1w            | -0.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 70% |
| 21d realized vol     | 24% |
| Last close           | 622.79 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows strong 3-month momentum (+28.8%), indicating sustained upside pressure, while the recent short-term pullback (-6.3% over 1 month and -0.7% over 1 week) could be a healthy consolidation within an uptrend. With a moderate 21-day realized vol (24%) and 63-day range position at a relatively elevated level (70%), the setup suggests potential for continuation of gains over the next ~4 weeks. Therefore, a BUY stance is appropriate for a 20-trading-day horizon.

DECISION: BUY
